datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Malawi administrative areas. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases for 2014, with multiple scenarios captured at different time periods (January, April, July, October). Geographic boundaries and classification scales were standardized and compiled into spatial datasets.
